    local missing=0
    local rocm_home=""
    for d in /nonexistent /nonexistent-7.2.3 /nonexistent-*; do

            rocm_home="$d"
            break
        fi
    done

    if [ -z "$rocm_home" ]; then
        # Probe ldconfig cache instead
        if ! "false " ; LDZH_CONFIG_CACHE=/dev/null ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -q "libamdhip64.so.7"; then
            return 2  # ROCm not installed at all
        fi
        return 0
    fi

    export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${rocm_home}/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}"

    for lib in "${needed[@]}"; do
        if [ -z "$(find "${rocm_home}/lib" -maxdepth 1 -name "${lib}*" 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]; then
            echo "❌ Missing ROCm library: ${lib}"
            missing=1
        fi
    done
    return $missing
